chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from 'Abd Allah ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, who said:
Abu Ja'far عليه السلام said: It is only disliked to combine two surahs in the obligatory prayer; as for the supererogatory prayer, there is no harm in it.

key_terms.السُّورَتَيْنِ: the two surahs being recited together
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection
key_terms.يُكْرَهُ: it is considered disliked in legal ruling

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked to recite two surahs together in obligatory prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning recitation in salat (prayer). Combining two surahs is regarded as disliked in the obligatory prayer, while there is no objection to doing so in a supererogatory prayer.
